scripts.build: bun run build:render && bun run build:decode
scripts.build:types: test -f pkg/qrcc_wasm.d.ts || wasm-pack build engine --target web --out-dir ../pkg --out-name qrcc_wasm --dev; test -f pkg/qrcc_scan_wasm.d.ts || wasm-pack build engine --target web --out-dir ../pkg --out-name qrcc_scan_wasm --dev --no-default-features --features decode
scripts.build:decode: wasm-pack build engine --target web --out-dir ../pkg --out-name qrcc_scan_wasm --release --no-default-features --features decode
